# S1 bring-up + S2 teleop tests (generated by `python -m sw.test_s2`)

1. Protocol tables: template build/parse round trip; the DM-J4310 table is complete; the GIM6010 table lists its TODOs.
2. Bring-up, DM-J4310 path (the real tables: GIM joints BLOCKED and held in the fixture) against the virtual bench arm:
   every step passes; the zero found against the hard stop matches the plant's hidden encoder offset; the measured
   gravity residual matches the plant's hidden errors (hand mass, torque constant) computed independently.
3. Bring-up, whole arm with the SIM PLACEHOLDER GIM table (exercises the GIM code path end to end): every step passes,
   all five zeros match, collision thresholds come out for every joint and load into sw/collision.py.
4. Fault injection (each must stop the bring-up at the right step, later steps REFUSED): motor at its factory ID,
   welded contactor, dead watchdog, drive without CAN timeout, drive that ignores its torque limit, motor mounted the
   other way round.
5. Teleop (sw/teleop_sim.py): 5 scripted-leader episodes through the supervisor recorded as LeRobot v3.0 and reloaded
   with the official loader; an extra episode with an e-stop is discarded and the arm stops.

- Protocol tables: template build/parse round trip; DM-J4310 table complete; GIM6010 table has 21 TODO fields ✅
- GIM protocol discovery (bring-up step 1, sw/gim_discover.py) against a simulated MIT-family drive: listen, no-torque exit-motor-mode probe answered on ID 1, zero-gain motor mode tracks a hand turn (0.23 rad, |τ| ≤ 0.10 N·m) ✅
- Bring-up, DM-J4310 path (GIM joints BLOCKED by their TODO table, held in the fixture): all 6 steps pass in 11 s (27142 cycles at 500 Hz); zero vs the hidden encoder offset 0.064°; gravity residual 0.091 N·m matches the plant's hidden hand mass + Kt error within 4 mN·m; sag test proves the drive clamp ✅
- Bring-up, whole arm with the SIM PLACEHOLDER GIM table: all 6 steps pass in 47 s; 5 zeros within 0.113° of the hidden offsets; jog tracking ≤ 2.4° at 10 % speed; effective balancer K 4.54 N·m (nominal 4.5, plant 4.725 + hidden mass/Kt); collision thresholds [0.92, 1.84, 0.68, 0.96, 0.3] N·m load into CollisionDetector ✅
- Fault injection, each caught at its step with every later step REFUSED: factory_id:wpitch → enumerate; estop_stuck → safety; watchdog_dead → safety; no_timeout → safety; no_clamp → gravity; reversed:wpitch → jog ✅
- Teleop (scripted leader → EEF delta → IK → supervisor at 500 Hz → MIT law on the twin): 5 episodes recorded (639 frames, 5/5 placed, loop 10.05 ms p50 / 19.95 ms p99 per 15 Hz step), reloaded with LeRobotDataset (v3.0, 639 frames, actions exact); the e-stop episode was discarded and the arm stopped (drift 55.0 mrad) ✅
